fusions.name: Surfacing Spring
fusions.desc: You spring up to 6 tiles to the target and strike it, dealing 14 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.5 times at maximum range.

fusions.name: Splashdown
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles of you takes a wall of water that deals 4 damage. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shoreward Lurch
fusions.desc: A sudden spring that carries you 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Chorus Partner
fusions.desc: A bonded frog swims beside you and strikes an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.3 seconds. Anything it hits moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
